facts.fact: Luca 三连问 Kayla 身份，Ares 护得生硬并反测他的反应
facts.anchor: She is none of your concern

facts.fact: Ares 以 Vero 砸吧往事警告 Luca 离 Kayla 远点
facts.anchor: She has surrounded herself with monsters, so I suggest you keep your eyes to yourself

facts.fact: Ares 拒绝给腹中异动命名，只登记为未计入的变量
facts.anchor: It’s not jealousy—I know that much. But Luca is a variable I haven’t accounted for

facts.fact: Ares 承认墓园那夜故意等到最后一秒：制造被需要的时刻是他的本能
facts.anchor: I wanted you to need me—it’s what I do. I create moments where I am needed

facts.fact: 被问对 Kayla 是否无感，Ares 第一次承认不知道
facts.anchor: I don’t know. And that’s the first time I have not known something about myself in a very long time

facts.fact: Kayla 交出完整史：父母情感操纵，nothing good enough
facts.anchor: My parents were emotionally manipulative, and nothing I did was ever good enough for them

facts.fact: Aaron 最终孤立她：无工作无友无家人，选择全被拿走
facts.anchor: In the end, I had no job, no friends, and no family. All my choices were taken away from me for so long

facts.fact: 章末 Ares 决定用她的历史绑住她，并自陈若有感觉会恨自己
facts.anchor: If I felt anything, I would hate myself for using that against her
